purpose.zh: 练低位开胯控制，为哥萨克蹲打基础
purpose.en: Build hip control in a low wide squat as a lead-in to the Cossack squat.

text.zh: 胸口挺起，重心慢慢移向一侧脚
text.en: Keep your chest tall and slowly shift your weight toward one foot

text.zh: 双脚约两倍髋宽，脚尖外转，脚跟踩地
text.en: Feet about twice hip-width, toes out, heels down.

text.zh: 弯曲的膝盖对准脚尖，经过中间再换边
text.en: Keep the bent knee over the toes, then pass through the middle to the other side.

cautions.zh: 膝或髋疼痛时蹲得浅一些，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Stay higher if your knees or hips hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
